children.name: Kewa acida  Christenh.
children.description: Kewa acida, commonly called the Salad Plant, is one of the eight species currently recognized in the genus Kewa, the sole genus in the family Kewaceae.

children.name: Kewa angrae-pequenae  Christenh.
children.description: The native range of this species is Namibia to W. Cape Prov.. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kewa arenicola  Christenh.
children.description: The native range of this species is Cape Prov. to North-West Province. It is a annual or subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kewa bowkeriana  Christenh.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Ethiopia to S. Africa. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kewa caespitosa  Christenh.
children.description: The native range of this species is Namibia, Free State. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kewa salsoloides  Christenh.
children.description: The native range of this species is SW. Angola to S. Africa and S. Mozambique. It is a annual or subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kewa suffruticosa  Christenh.
children.description: The native range of this species is Madagascar. It grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kewa trachysperma  Christenh.
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Cape Prov.. It is a annual or subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
